Senses.Explanation: Before the hall of the bright moon: the always-summer inside the coldest frame — the back half of the couplet the Caodong line built its five positions on, from Dongshan's inscription down to the memorial-day haze. Dongshan Liangjie sets the root in the Inscription on the Mystery-Within: fact and principle both bright, essence and function unblocked — the purport of the mystery-within is right here — under the sun's gate, day after day, the deep-month autumn; before the hall of the bright moon, hour after hour, the ninth-month summer; the myriad forms filling the sky, the old buddha's household style, the azure vault above, the wanderer's livelihood; Wansong Xingxiu, in the Record of the Congrong Hermitage, hands down the grading: Caoshan Benji said the world's coarse and heavy greed, anger, and delusion, though hard to cut, are light — it is the no-affair, no-deed purity that is heavy beyond adding — and that is why Dongshan said, before the hall of the bright moon, hour after hour summer; the ultimate way cannot be pictured; the old ones took it near from the body, far from things, pairing and likening to hint at it; Danxia Zichun verses the halfway house: gate-head and door-edge affairs by the thousand — see through them all and you still have not reached home; before the hall of the bright moon the shadowless tree, on the strictest frozen snow-night, precisely in bloom; Hongzhi Zhengjue takes the middle of the month: right on the fifteenth day, see through both ends, and it comes to lord and vassal joined in the way, father and son in accord — on the glazed-tile hall the jade girl tosses her head, before the hall of the bright moon the stone man claps his hands; step back, and it is letting go the hands over the ten-thousand-fathom cliff; step forward, and it is turning the body at the hundred-foot pole's tip. Foyan Qingyuan closes the hall address on Vairocana: want to know it? Under the great sun's gate, day after day, autumn; before the hall of the bright moon, hour after hour, summer — and what after all is Vairocana? — back to the hall, drink your tea — and he steps down; Linquan Conglun grades the half-way monk: this is still only pulling the body out at half road, you have by no means reached home — you must go from the partial into the true with the paired-through carrying, to take your ease before the hall of the bright moon, hour after hour summer, and be waited on under the sun's gate, day after day autumn — in the shadowless grove the ancient trees stand tiered, on Dayu ridge the cold plum splits into fragrance; Yuan'an Liao puts it to the assembly himself: cold — the whole sky wrapped cold; hot — the whole sky wrapped hot; hot it bakes you shaven-heads, cold it kills you — why then do they say under the sun's gate always autumn, before the hall of the bright moon always summer? Put the one eye in there, and you slip loose past the Sound-of-Awe side, back before the empty kalpa — fingers cracked and dropped by freezing, yet not cold; stone and gold glowing melted, yet not hot; Faxi Yin, on his late teacher's memorial day, after the pair of answers on father and son meeting, gives it in haze: before the hall of the bright moon, green hills banked in gray mist; outside the hall of the empty king, blue-green water rolling on — bamboo dancing on a thousand peaks, incense burning in the jade holder, and still the gut secretly knotted, the heart's square inch sighing — the yellow flowers weep the autumn dew in the end-tracking of the far-gone; and do you all know the late teacher's coming and going? Never born — how would he end?
